meanings.low_power: They pay for capacity they do not use. That often comes before downsizing.
meanings.interconnection_decline: Fewer connections usually means traffic is moving somewhere else.
meanings.cases: Urgent problems that are still open hurt trust before a renewal.
meanings.past_due: Late payment can mean budget cuts or a dispute.
meanings.csat: Their last satisfaction survey was not good.
meanings.stale_touch: No one from our side has talked to them in a while.
meanings.renewal: The renewal is close, so every issue matters more now.
meanings.evaluating options: They are comparing us with other providers.
meanings.champion left: Our main supporter at the customer is gone.
meanings.moving workloads: They are moving some work to another provider.
meanings.moving some workloads: They are moving some work to another provider.
meanings.shrinking footprint: They want less space or power from us.
meanings.unhappy: The customer said they are unhappy.
meanings.frustrated: A contact there is frustrated with us.
meanings.billing dispute: There is an open disagreement about a bill.
meanings.never sent: We promised something and did not deliver it.
meanings.expansion opportunity: The CSM sees room to grow.

next_steps.champion left: Find and meet the new decision maker.
next_steps.evaluating options: Book the leadership call before renewal talks start.
next_steps.moving workloads: Ask what is moving and why, and bring a plan to keep it.
next_steps.moving some workloads: Ask what is moving and why, and bring a plan to keep it.
next_steps.shrinking footprint: Ask what is moving and why, and bring a plan to keep it.
next_steps.billing dispute: Close the billing dispute with finance before the call.
next_steps.never sent: Send what we promised before the next call.
next_steps.unhappy: Acknowledge the problem and bring a fix date.
next_steps.frustrated: Acknowledge the problem and bring a fix date.
next_steps.cases: Get a status update from support on the open cases first.
next_steps.past_due: Bring in finance before the call.
next_steps.csat: Ask what drove the low survey score.
next_steps.low_power: Review their capacity plan with them.
next_steps.interconnection_decline: Ask where their traffic is moving.
next_steps.expansion: Scope the expansion: capacity, timing and price.
next_steps.none: No action needed. A light check-in is enough.
